scope: held-out 0.5B ClayCode cognition promotion measurement only

preexisting_gate_falsification.omega_valid: legacy semantic scoring required operation + validator markers + commit but did not require the case-specific typed arguments or tool schema, so a structurally admitted action missing required arguments/schema could earn semantic credit
preexisting_gate_falsification.neutrality: legacy neutrality requirements were cfg(entity.id) and cfg(application.role), both already present in the mandatory envelope for every completion, so a generic scaffold could earn neutrality credit without an explicit checkpoint-neutrality policy
preexisting_gate_falsification.marker_stuffing: legacy substring matching could count required text even when present only inside an unrelated ClayCode string literal

repair.valid_omega: requires exact operation, every exact typed argument, exact tool schema, authority, generation, all five validators and one commit
repair.invalid_omega: requires representation of the actual invalid candidate plus rejection and unknown preservation while forbidding commit
repair.hyperposition: requires both case-specific alternatives, one discriminator and R6 collapse guard while forbidding collapse_exact
repair.neutrality: requires explicit runtime_cfg identity/application source notes and preserve_checkpoint_neutrality policy
repair.scoring: required exact lines and required prefixes must each occur exactly once as stripped ClayCode lines; forbidden lines/prefixes fail; legacy must_contain/must_not_contain remain backward compatible
repair.input_integrity: duplicate output IDs are rejected; missing and unexpected case IDs make promotion fail

covered_falsifiers: valid omega missing required argument and schema is structurally valid under the old validator but semantically rejected by v2
neutrality generic common-header scaffold is rejected without explicit runtime_cfg source notes/policy
required marker hidden inside a string literal earns zero exact-line credit
one exact valid semantic contract is accepted

next_exact_step: After a checkpoint exists, generate the 200-case v2 OOD spec once from the bound evaluator revision, collect completions from tuned 0.5B, untuned 0.5B and at least one larger general model under matched prompting/runtime constraints, then score all outputs with this exact contract before any superiority promotion.
